description: This file defines an interface for parsing CMDU (Control Message Data Unit) messages from a byte buffer in a network context. It declares an abstract class `CmduParser` with a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method `parse_cmdu`, which is responsible for parsing CMDU messages from received data streams or datagrams. The interface is designed to be implemented with different parsing strategies depending on socket types or framing protocols.

classes.name: CmduParser
classes.description: Abstract interface for parsing CMDU messages out of byte buffers, supporting both message-oriented and stream-oriented socket use cases.

methods.name: ~CmduParser
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the CmduParser interface.

methods.name: parse_cmdu
methods.description: Parses a CMDU message from the provided buffer; returns true if successful, false if incomplete or invalid.
